verdict.rationale: Phaser's docs treat 2D as the core workflow. They cover sprite game objects, sprite sheets and atlases, frame-based animation, and Arcade Physics on sprites with velocity, acceleration and gravity. Community users independently describe it as a 2D framework built for 'sprites, tilemaps, physics' and as the best option for 2D browser games. Missing for 10: first-party runtime tilemap API documentation (tilemaps appear only as an editor feature and in community remarks), and evidence of a 2D physics option beyond Arcade, which is limited to rectangles and circles.
